abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Your dodge chance increases sharply for a short time.
abilities._design_note: Not learned from level alone - granted by the Evasion talent in the Combat tree, matching real WOTLK where this is talent-exclusive, not baseline. The rogue's dodge chance will increase for a short time.
abilities._source: UNGATED 5 Nov 2026. It was requires_talent, and its only unlock node was a node in rogue_combat whose talent_id was rogue_combat_RIPOSTE while its display name read 'Evasion' - a leftover from an earlier pass. The Combat rebuild gave Riposte its own correctly-named node (Riposte IS a real 3.3.5a Combat talent at row 2), which left Evasion with nothing unlocking it. Ungating is the faithful fix rather than inventing an Evasion talent: in real WoW Evasion is a baseline rogue ability learned from a trainer at level 8, and it appears nowhere in any of the three 3.3.5a talent trees.
